What is Lumin AirTv

Flying projection spheres for events, brands and cities. Your video, logo or live broadcast on a 180° sphere screen.

The sphere brings large-format video to places where an ordinary screen cannot be installed. It works indoors and outdoors and needs no wall or stage to hold it.

Its 180° screen shows any video: a clip, a logo or a live camera feed. In daylight it is a large light sphere above the crowd. After sunset the screen lights up.

It fits concerts and festivals, trade fairs, product launches and corporate events. It also suits city celebrations, parks, stadiums and arenas, hotels, marinas and private events, for one evening or as a longer installation.
